name: Ford F-150 Raptor

hotspots.name: 3.5L EcoBoost High Output V6
hotspots.details: Under the hood of the second-generation Raptor sits Ford's twin-turbocharged, intercooled 3.5-litre EcoBoost High Output V6. Ford rates the 2019 Raptor at 450 hp at 5,000 rpm and 510 lb-ft at 3,500 rpm, driving through a 10-speed SelectShift automatic and Torque-On-Demand 4x4.

hotspots.name: FOX Racing Shox with Live Valve
hotspots.details: The Raptor uses high-output, gas-pressurised FOX Racing Shox front and rear. From 2019 they have Live Valve technology: electronically controlled, continuously variable compression damping that adjusts to the terrain in real time. The front suspension is an independent double-wishbone coil-over set-up.

hotspots.name: BFGoodrich All-Terrain T/A KO2 tyres
hotspots.details: Ford fits 315/70 R17 BFGoodrich All-Terrain T/A KO2 tyres as standard, on 17-inch cast aluminium wheels with a machined face. Forged bead-lock-capable 17-inch wheels were optional.

hotspots.name: FORD heritage grille
hotspots.details: Instead of the blue oval, the Raptor wears large block FORD letters across a black grille, a design that recalls older Ford trucks. In this model the letters are finished in bright silver.

hotspots.name: Quad-beam LED headlamps
hotspots.details: Ford lists quad-beam LED headlamps with daytime running lamps on the Raptor, plus LED tail lamps, integrated marker lights and a tailgate LED.

hotspots.name: High-strength aluminium body
hotspots.details: The Raptor's cab and bed are made of aluminium alloy, mounted on a high-strength steel frame. This kept the weight down compared with an all-steel body.

hotspots.name: Wide flared fenders
hotspots.details: Flared fenders cover the Raptor's wider track and long-travel suspension. Ford quotes an overall width of 96.8 inches including mirrors, much wider than a standard F-150.

hotspots.name: Front skid plate with tow hooks
hotspots.details: A skid plate under the front bumper protects the underbody when driving off-road, with recovery tow hooks set into the bumper. On this model it is shown in dark satin.

hotspots.name: SuperCrew four-door cab
hotspots.details: The Raptor was offered as a SuperCab or a SuperCrew. This model is the four-door SuperCrew, which Ford quotes with a 146-inch wheelbase, a 231.9-inch overall length and a 36-gallon fuel tank.

hotspots.name: Aluminium cargo bed
hotspots.details: Like the cab, the cargo bed is aluminium alloy. The SuperCrew Raptor pairs the four-door cab with a 5.5-foot bed.

note: User-supplied model; unknown licence; personal use only. Hover labels describe the real second-generation Ford F-150 Raptor; the game-derived mesh has been re-materialled and lightly edited (grille D rebuilt, roof rack removed, skid plate trimmed) and is not an exact replica.
